Plan_of_Care.content: For gastroenteritis/diarrhea: encourage oral rehydration and increased fluid intake
For gastroenteritis/diarrhea: monitor for fever and stay home until improving
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Monitor for fever; stay home until improving

Plan_of_Care.content: For gastroenteritis/diarrhea: avoid antibiotics as they may worsen condition
Safety-net advice: if symptoms worsen or do not improve, book in-person GP review for abdominal examination
